name: Gudeg (Green Jackfruit Stew)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 lb (1 kg) chicken (cut into small pieces with bone)

steps: Cut jackfruit into 1 inch-thick pieces and wash.
Boil jackfruit in water until tender. Drain.
Grind shallots, candle nuts, garlic, salam leaves, and galangal together until fragrant. Add the chicken pieces and toss to coat.
Stir-fry chicken until it changes color. Add 4 cups of water and coconut sugar, and bring to a boil.
Add jackfruit and simmer until chicken and vegetables are tender.
Add coconut milk 5 minutes before it's done; bring back to a boil.

culture.text: Gudeg is a traditional Javanese dish from Yogyakarta, Indonesia. It is made from young, unripe jackfruit stewed for several hours with palm sugar and coconut milk. It is variously spiced with garlic, shallot, candlenut, coriander seed, galangal, bay leaves, and teak leaves, the latter giving the dish a reddish-brown color. It is sometimes called "green jack fruit sweet stew".
